title: UserAlertX — SMS Alerts for AI Agents
excerpt: Let your AI agent, bot or script send you a text or email alert - to your own verified phone, and only yours. One HTTP POST. Free to start.
content_html:
Texting for AI agents

UserAlertX (aka User Alerts)

Texting for your GrokBot, AI bot, AI agent or program to reach you now.

A texting channel for AI agents and automations. One verified phone number, no way to message anyone but you, 10dlc registered and carrier-compliant from day one. One unified interface for SMS texting and email.

Free trial, immediate operation, low cost. Get operational immediately.

Instruction: GrokBot · ChatGPT · API

What is UserAlertX?

A cloud texting App built for one person: You, Now, Free, then Cheap!

UserAlertX is an API-first SMS product built for automations. Sign up, verify your own mobile number, and that number is the only place the platform will ever text — no directory, no bulk list, no ability to message anyone else. Your bots send a request, you get a text.
(For business or groups, see MemberAlertX.com.)

curl -X POST https://useralertx.com/cgi-bin/itsignup.cgi \ -d email="[email protected]" \ -d to="1112223333" \ -d body="your automation finished"

  1. 1. You'll get a start/stop text on your phone.
  2. 2. You'll get an email asking to confirm your address.
  3. 3. Your email gets a 2FA verification request.
  4. 4. Your texts start going straight through.
  5. 5. Texting a different phone number from this account gets rejected as non-member.

This itsignup.cgi call, the Try It Now page, and Get Started all create/reach the same kind of account — pick whichever's convenient, they're not separate systems.

Why your bot needs its own alert channel

Built around one constraint

Carriers and The Campaign Registry punish open-ended messaging. A product that can only text the opted-in owner of an account is one of the cleanest stories you can register.

01

One verified number

The recipient is always the same person who created the account and completed SMS opt-in — enforced in code, not just policy.

02

No way to spam

There's no way to send to anyone else. No marketing content, no purchased lists, no third-party recipients — structurally, not just by promise.

03

Carrier-compliant

Registered on a real 10DLC number, with full STOP/START/HELP keyword handling built in from the start.

04

Carrier-restricted content

Phone carriers don't allow certain topics in text messages, even in an alert to yourself — stocks, trading and investment tips, cryptocurrency, loans and more. Every alert is checked first; a carrier-restricted alert is sent to you by email, complete, and your phone gets a short notice. See the list

Key capabilities

Everything a bot needs to reach you

→

Simple HTTP send APIOne POST request, no SDK required

→

Email + SMS double opt-inConfirm by email, confirm by text

→

Reply keywords: START / STOP / P / SResume, opt out, pause, flag as spam, or EMAIL to switch to email alerts — just reply to the text

→

Delivery statusSee which alerts were delivered on your Recent alerts page

→

Free tier included50 free alerts in your first 30 days, no card required upfront

→

Held-message queueFirst message waits for opt-in, then releases automatically

Give your bot a way to reach you

Free to start. Confirmed in two steps: an email link, then a text reply.

Get Started
